responsibility: Declares the SysExceptions interface used to connect host-level fault handling to the GNU Modula-2 runtime by registering callback procedures for each language/runtime exception class. It defines the low-level OS exception hookup contract that GRTExceptions and M2RTS build upon, rather than exporting exception blocks or user diagnostics directly.
same_name_distinction: Declares the SysExceptions callback signature and InitExceptionHandlers registration API, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSysExceptions.cc supplies the actual OS signal handlers and sigaction-based wiring to those callbacks.
